# oa

> Python interface to OpenAI


## Pages in this subsection

- [oa](oa.html.md): Python facade to OpenAi functionality.
- [oa.ask](oa.ask.html.md): Access to already made prompt functions
- [oa.audio](oa.audio.html.md): OpenAI Audio tools
- [oa.base](oa.base.html.md): Base oa functionality
- [oa.batch_embeddings](oa.batch_embeddings.html.md): Simplified interface for computing embeddings in bulk using OpenAI’s batch API.
- [oa.batches](oa.batches.html.md): Batch functionality
- [oa.chats](oa.chats.html.md): Tools to work with shared chats (conversations).
- [oa.oa_types](oa.oa_types.html.md): Types for oa
- [oa.openai_specs](oa.openai_specs.html.md): Tools to extract specs from the openai interface
- [oa.stores](oa.stores.html.md): Data object layers for openai resources
- [oa.tools](oa.tools.html.md): Interface tools
- [oa.util](oa.util.html.md): | &#96;chunk_iterable&#96;(iterable, chk_size, &#92;&#42;&#91;, ...&#93;)   | Divide an iterable into chunks/batches of a sp...
- [oa.vector_stores](oa.vector_stores.html.md): Vector stores and search
